notes.body:
Canagliflozin body model
Distribution of canagliflozin and its glucuronides M5 and M7 with the blood flow, the tissue distribution of canagliflozin, the hepatic and renal metabolism, the biliary excretion of the metabolites with the hydrolysis of the glucuronides in the intestine, and the renal excretion.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

body.p: GFR per renal blood flow (76.3 ml/l, a ratio of 0.0763). Calibrated so that the healthy GFR is 101 ml/min at the renal blood flow of 1.32354 l/min of 75 kg, the normal GFR of the classes of renal impairment (pkpdsim.impairment).
The GFR of healthy kidneys, which scales with the renal blood flow and so with the body weight; the GFR is KI__f_renal_function times this rate.
Scaling factor of the UGT1A9 activity of the liver and the kidney, which form M7; an inducer or inhibitor changes both. 1.0: normal activity; <1.0 decreased activity; >1.0 increased activity.
